_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbWjYFBwPKy4wWAQDz2ZW8py)_

Closes #25754 (ruling A, comment 6398564883).

## What changed

Only the last prose paragraph of `.changeset/25610-notify-email-field-recipient.md`. It said delivery "lands separately; until it does, a run that reaches such a node fails at the node". #25721 delivered it, and `.changeset/25571-notify-email-field-delivery.md` ships in the same release. The paragraph now ends "ships in the same release in `@objectstack/service-automation`." Frontmatter, `Clause-②:` and `Metadata-protocol:` are byte-identical.

## Landing point

The expected one, `.changeset/25610-notify-email-field-recipient.md`. The sentence is the changeset's own text, so there is no other producer.

## Expected red

`Check Changeset` stays red by design (#17712 ruling D: correcting a pending release note is a release decision). The maintainer confirms and merges past it. This must land before #25640 (Version Packages) consumes the changeset. #25640 is untouched.

## Acceptance notes

No `skip-changeset` label: the edit changes published CHANGELOG text.
